notes.title: The 25th Ward: The Silver Case 50% off until February 4th!
notes.notes:
Grasshopper Manufacture Inc.'s timeless classic The 25th Ward: The Silver Case is now 50% off from now until February 4th! 

Do yourself a favor and curl up with this intoxicating mystery today, a game which GameSpot says, "[..] consistently commands your attention with frighteningly relevant themes, bonkers plot twists, or even just the simple thrill of some beautifully rendered and twisted imagery."
